platform.viewAsHint: How others see the apps - only for you as a superuser, switch back any time.

week.title: Week {{week}}
week.switchText: The old template's blocks are replaced - including your changes to them. Your own blocks and modules stay.

templates.title: Templates
templates.lead: What your days usually look like - and modules like training.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Create the first one!

kindHint.day: For weekdays - a day starts as a copy of it.
kindHint.module: Fits into any day, e.g. training.

template.name: Name
template.deleteText: "{{name}}" disappears. Days already made from it keep their blocks.
template.unused: Not assigned to a weekday yet.
template.tapHint: Tap a block to change it - or a free spot for a new one.

delay.title: When a block runs over
delay.lead: Applies to every day that doesn't say otherwise - switch it per day.

hint.fixed: Blocks stay where they are - even when one runs over.
hint.cascade: When a block runs over (+15 min, pulled longer, done late), the following ones move back - up to the next gap.

short.fixed: Off - blocks stay where they are.
short.cascade: On - when a block runs over, the next ones move back.

push.title: Notifications
push.ios3: Open Day from the home screen and turn it on here.

state.needs-install: On iPhone, notices only work when Day is on the home screen:
state.denied: Blocked - allow notifications in the browser's settings.
state.server-off: Not set up on the server yet.

calendar.title: Calendars
calendar.lead: Appointments from Outlook, iCloud or Google show hatched in the day - read-only, synced every 15 minutes.
calendar.deleteText: The appointments from "{{name}}" disappear from day and week. The calendar itself stays as it is.
calendar.name: Name
calendar.urlHint: Starts with webcal:// or https:// and often ends in .ics. Treat it like a password - it won't be shown again.
calendar.where: Where do I find the address?

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.steps: Outlook on the web → Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → "Publish a calendar" → copy the ICS link. For work accounts, IT decides whether this is allowed.

icloud.name: iCloud
icloud.steps: Calendar app → (i) next to the calendar → turn on "Public Calendar" → share/copy the link.

google.name: Google
google.steps: Google Calendar on the web → Settings → pick the calendar → copy "Secret address in iCal format".

errors.scheme: The address has to start with https:// or webcal://.
errors.credentials: Addresses with a user name or password don't work.
errors.unreachable: The calendar's server can't be reached.
errors.http: The calendar answers with error {{status}} - is the address still valid?
errors.too_big: The calendar is too big (over 5 MB).
errors.not_ics: There's no calendar file (ICS) at that address.
errors.timeout: The calendar took too long - try again later.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.lead: How much of the plan really happened.
stats.empty: Nothing ticked off yet - mark blocks done or skip them and this fills up.
